sheets.prompt: Character design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one sentinel, a defunct humanoid guard droid of an ancient vanished civilisation, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view behind its shield, side view, three-quarter view, and its attack wind-up with a blade arm drawn back and its shield arm forward. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade backpack stands beside it for scale; the sentinel is 2 metres tall, slim and upright. Design: human proportions and joints, a smooth ancient body of pale ivory ceramic panels over dark jointed limbs, one round glowing amber eye in a narrow smooth head, a round shield built into its left forearm and a straight blade extending from its right; weathered, chipped and stained with age, a little moss in the joints, glowing amber seams. Still and precise, it moves in sudden bursts. Original design, medium detail, a strong readable silhouette. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, cream paper grain, evenly spaced views, fully visible bodies, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, lettering, labels, scenery, hollow knight, white mask, drapes, bandages, mummy, robes, gore.
